key_insights: Funding rates on perpetual swaps reached 25% annualized at peak, then went negative during crash, now back to 7%
Institutional players were fading the move on the way up according to b2c2 flows
GBTC premium went negative for first time (-17.5%), creating opportunity
Altcoin decoupling narrative hasn't come to fruition - when BTC crashed, everything crashed with it
Market structure has two layers: inside spread (HFTs) and outside spread (hedge funds providing real liquidity)
Options market makers hedging call options may be supporting funding rates
Privacy coins may gain traction on narrative of asset protection
Arca fund provides free alpha with analysis of DeFi tokens treated as businesses
summary: The crypto market experienced a 55% correction from $60k with institutions selling on the way up. Max identified a rare opportunity when GBTC premium went negative to -17.5% combined with BTC at $30k. The hosts believe we may see $40-50k again. Altcoin decoupling narratives failed during the crash. Privacy coins and DeFi fundamentals remain long-term themes.
